description: 1st-order upwind grad rule on a sinusoidally-stretched non-uniform 1D periodic domain. Grid spacing dx[i] = h*(1 + 0.3*sin(2*pi*(i-1)/N)) with h=L/N, so total length is preserved. Tests that per-cell dx[i] coefficients are applied correctly.

tolerance.notes: Upwind coefficients are simple rationals in dx[i]; should be bit-identical across bindings to this tolerance.

fixtures.name: advection_nonuniform_periodic
fixtures.notes: 80-cell sinusoidally-stretched grid on [0,2] with periodic BCs. Gaussian IC matching the uniform upwind test. Stretching amplitude 0.3: dx[i]=h*(1+0.3*sin(2*pi*(i-1)/80)), h=2/80=0.025.
